test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can do a work in 30 days and B can do the same work in 40 days. They work together for 8 days and then B leaves the work. In how many days will A finish the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 30 days

B can complete the work in 40 days

They work together for 8 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

Calculation:

LCM(30,40) = 120 (Total work units)

Work done per day: A = 120/30 = 4, B = 120/40 = 3

Work done together per day = 4 + 3 = 7

Work done in 8 days = 8 × 7 = 56

Remaining work = 120 - 56 = 64

A alone completes 4 units/day

Days required = 64/4 = 16

**∴ A will finish the remaining work in 16 days.**
